name: Kosjenka
description: Star of 5,550 K, 291 parsecs away, with 1 transiting planet.

text.card: WASP-63 b crosses Kosjenka as seen from Earth, which is how it was found.
text.introduction: Its radius and temperature follow Stassun et al. 2017.

quotes.title: WASP-63
quotes.card: WASP-63, also named Kosjenka, is a single star with an exoplanetary companion in the southern constellation of Columba.
quotes.introduction: It is too faint to be visible with the naked eye, having an apparent visual magnitude of 11.1.
